data.one_liner: A Material-style date picker and form fields showing both Gregorian and Hebrew dates.
data.what_it_does: Provides Material-style date pickers, date range pickers, and form fields that integrate Hebrew (Jewish) calendar dates alongside Gregorian ones. It supports multiple calendar view modes, holiday markers, and helper extensions for DateTime objects.
use_when: You need to collect or display Hebrew dates in a Flutter app
You want Material date pickers that seamlessly display both Gregorian and Hebrew calendars
You require form validation for Hebrew dates using standard form fields
avoid_when: Your app does not require Hebrew or Jewish calendar support
You need a completely custom calendar interface unrelated to Material Design
strengths: Supports both single dates and date ranges with Hebrew calendar integration
Includes embeddable widgets, dialogs, and FormField implementations
Provides holiday and Yom Tov calculations and decorations
weaknesses: Limited to Material Design styling out of the box
Depends on specific third-party packages like kosher_dart and table_calendar
data.setup_notes: No native permissions or complex setup required. Locale data formatting may need initialization if using locales other than en_US.
